subject: Shiny Server Installation Missing Conf File

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Shiny Server Installation Missing Conf File
parts:
I installed Shiny Server from source on a 32-bit Ubuntu 15 computer. When I run shiny-server I get :

$ /usr/local/shiny-server/bin/shiny-server
[2015-08-05 01:04:08.515] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v1.4.0.0 (Node.js v0.10.21)
[2015-08-05 01:04:08.521] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf"
[2015-08-05 01:04:08.572] [ERROR] shiny-server - Error loading config: File "/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf" does not exist
[2015-08-05 01:04:08.573] [INFO] shiny-server - Shutting down worker processes

Indeed, it's missing :

$ sudo ls -l /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf
ls: cannot access /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf: No such file or directory

I followed the commands at https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Building-Shiny-Server-from-Source

If I manually create the file and try running it again,

$ sudo /usr/local/shiny-server/bin/shiny-server
[2015-08-05 01:07:23.644] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v1.4.0.0 (Node.js v0.10.21)
[2015-08-05 01:07:23.649] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf"
[2015-08-05 01:07:23.732] [WARN] shiny-server - Running as root unnecessarily is a security risk! You could be running more securely as non-root.
[2015-08-05 01:07:23.738] [INFO] shiny-server - Starting listener on 0.0.0.0:3838

It stays at this output line until I kill it.

Has anyone else experienced this ? Or, have I missed an important stage of the installation ? I re-ran all of the commands, and the problem remains. Is there any hope of having 32-bit binaries available online soon ? 32-bit servers are useful for applications that don't need much RAM.
